dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts visitors to the Marshall House, the designated management entity, and local historical preservation efforts in Virginia.
dimensions.evidence: The General George C. Marshall House in the Commonwealth of Virginia is established as an affiliated area of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Designates an existing historic house as an affiliated park area and permits technical and financial assistance agreements without transferring property ownership to the federal government.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section authorizes the Secretary-- (1) to acquire property at the affiliated area; or (2) to assume overall financial responsibility

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the Department of the Interior to provide financial and technical assistance, but explicitly bars assuming overall financial responsibility for operations.
dimensions.evidence: provide financial assistance for the marketing, marking, interpretation, and preservation of the affiliated area

dimensions.assessment: Applies a specific honorary designation and cooperative framework to one historical site.
dimensions.evidence: The General George C. Marshall House in the Commonwealth of Virginia is established as an affiliated area of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent affiliated status and ongoing cooperative agreement framework for the site.
dimensions.evidence: designated as an affiliated area of the National Park System, and for other purposes.

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts authorized or appropriated for financial assistance.
importance_detail.rationale: The enacted bill designates the General George C. Marshall House in Virginia as an affiliated area of the National Park System, establishing a management entity and cooperative agreement framework without federal property acquisition.
